notes.subject: מִפְלְשֵׂי
notes.rationale: Occurs only here; meaning uncertain — 'balancings/spreadings' of the cloud.

notes.subject: מִפְלְאֹות
notes.rationale: This plural noun form occurs only here (elsewhere the feminine מִפְלָאָה with suffix).

notes.subject: עַל
notes.rationale: The preposition before מִפְלְשֵׂי is awkward: 'Do you know concerning the balancings...' — object marker or 'upon', readings differ.

notes.subject: to Job
notes.rationale: Second interrogative challenge in a row to Job's knowledge.

notes.subject: מִפְלְשֵׂי / מִפְלְאֹות
notes.rationale: Near-identical sounds (mifl-) in parallel cola; the echo is lost in English.

translation: Do you know the spreadings-out of the cloud, the wonders of one perfect in knowledge?
